_invalid_because: commitment.designated_roles is typed array (RFC-MACP-0010 §6). A bare string is the natural single-role shorthand a policy author would reach for, and JSON Schema will not coerce it. Isolates the type keyword -- deliberately NOT paired with authority 'designated_role', because handoff-rules.schema.json has no conditional arm requiring the field, so adding one would not change the rejection and would blur which keyword fires.
